label: Threat-Path Methodology
description: Codifies the universal seven-stage causal chain at the heart of the Risk Atlas: Exposure → Threat Path → Vulnerability → Inherent → Controls (Prevent/Detect/Respond) → Residual → Appetite. Generalised from the CASP business-wide risk assessment methodology; equivalent to ISO 31000 Bowtie, NIST CSF (Identify→Protect→Detect→Respond→Recover), and FMEA/HAZOP at structural level.
